_**Agent (grok-4.7)**_

The CSS build error is gone. The dev server is running again on Node 22.23.2 at http://localhost:3000, and `/deals` returns 200 with both Tailwind and the React Flow stylesheet compiled.

The failure came from the Node version, not from `@xyflow/react`. The previous server was Node **20.18.3**. Tailwind v4 loads `magic-string` with `require()`, and that package is ESM-only. Node 20.18 cannot load it, so every CSS file — including `globals.css` and `@xyflow/react/dist/style.css` — failed while Turbopack ran PostCSS. Node 22 can load that module, which is why `.nvmrc` pins 22.

Your shell’s default is still Node 20.18.3. Before you start the app again from that terminal, run:

```bash
nvm use
npm run dev
```
